    Bug 2012697 - Migrate FilterListDialog to Fluent. r=coreyb,mkmelin
    
    
    This patch migrates the Message Filters list dialog from legacy DTD and
    properties files to Fluent. It moves localized strings for the main
    filter list, the "Running Filters" prompt, and confirmation dialogs
    into filterEditor.ftl.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D282316
